RESOLVER
Description
These commands allow you to resolve names and addresses using the DNS
subsystem configured on BIG-IP.
Command List
DNSMSG
- commands allow you process DNS responses
RESOLVER::name_lookup
- performs a DNS lookup.
RESOLVER::summarize
- returns a summary of the DNS response.
